{"metadata":{"description":"Send files from your DeepSeek Harness agent straight to your phone, and reference what your phone sent back — no account, no public IP, end-to-end encrypted.","id":"gh:1341317053","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-swarmdrop","slug":"swarm-apps/dsh-swarmdrop","topics":["cordis-plugin","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","file-transfer","p2p"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Send files from your DeepSeek Harness agent straight to your phone, and reference what your phone se"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nt back — no account, no public IP, end-to-end encrypted."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-swarmdrop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Give your DeepSeek Harness agent a
channel to your own devices. It can push what it just produced st"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"raight to your
phone, and you can `@`-reference what your phone sent back — no account, no public
IP"},{"id":"p3s3","text":", end-to-end encrypted."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The transport is SwarmDrop, driven through
its CLI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Status: developer preview.** dsh itself declares breaking changes, and this
> plugin sits on its"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" extension seams. Pin a version.
>
> **Pin the dsh line too.** The peer ranges target `0.1.0-rc.x`; "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"npm's `latest`
> tag on the `@deepseek-ai/*` packages still points at the older `0.0.1-rc.x`
> line,"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" so an unpinned install resolves to packages this plugin does not target."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| In dsh | What happens |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| "send the report to my phone" | The agent calls `swarmdrop_send_files`; a transfer row appears in "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"the conversation and follows it to completion. |
| `/swarmdrop send ./report.pdf phone` | Same, with"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"out a model round trip. |
| `@` in the composer | Your inbox — everything your devices sent this mac"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"hine — as reference candidates. |
| Your phone sends a file | A row appears in the conversation, and"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" the item becomes referenceable. |
| **The SwarmDrop button at the sidebar foot** | Node status and "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"network posture, start/stop, your paired devices, and pairing a new one — without leaving dsh for a "},{"id":"p8s7","text":"terminal. |
| **Settings → SwarmDrop** | Everything that needs room: invites and revoking them, the "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"whole inbox, transfer history and its controls, this machine's name and receive directory, bootstrap"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ox, transfer history and its controls, this machine's name and receive directory, bootstrap nodes. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### The panel"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"A dot beside Settings says whether a node is running: green for running, amber
for stopped, grey whi"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"le the first answer is still in flight. Opening it gives you"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Node** — running or stopped, its node id, and one button to change that.
- **Network** — NAT cla"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ss, relay reservation, bootstrap, connected peers, listen
addresses. Shown only while a node is runn"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ing, because every field would
otherwise read "unknown" and say nothing the node row did not.
- **De"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"vices** — what is paired and whether it is online. `unknown` is its own
state, not a synonym for off"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"line.
- **Pairing** — "Add a device" issues an invite and staffs the desk, then opens
a dialog showi"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ng it as a **QR code** for your phone to scan, with the link
behind a copy button for when scanning "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"is not an option. When a device shows
up, a second dialog gives you its name, system, link type and "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"**full node id**
before you decide — and it opens whether or not the panel is showing, because
a req"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"uest nobody answers is a device that just times out."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Pairing still requires a person to look at the far side's identity — that has not
been relaxed, only"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" moved. An invite is a one-shot capability that travels as a
link, and whoever presents it first con"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"sumes it, so SwarmDrop's node refuses
every inbound request unless someone is at the desk."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**The desk stays staffed until you press "Cancel pairing"**, not until you close
the dialog — copyin"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"g the link is *in order to* go paste it somewhere, so the
dialog is always closed mid-pairing, and c"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"losing it must not end what the far
side is halfway through. The Pairing section keeps a "pairing in"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" progress" row
with a way back in, and the sidebar dot turns amber-grey, so a desk left staffed
is v"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"isible without opening anything."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The QR code is rendered by `swarmdrop` itself, not by the browser. SwarmDrop
encodes every one of it"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"s surfaces through one module, and that module also
decides how many dialable addresses fit on the c"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ode and drops the rest — work
that needs the invite's structure opened up. A second encoder in the b"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"rowser
would quietly produce codes a camera cannot read."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### The settings page"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The panel is a status light; the page is where the occasional work happens.
Seven sections, each rea"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"d when you open it and re-read when you ask — never on
a timer, because every one of them costs a `s"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" and re-read when you ask — never on
a timer, because every one of them costs a `swarmdrop` process."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Overview** — the panel's facts, unabbreviated: every listen address, the
full node id, every pai"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"red device with its identity.
- **Invites** — what this machine has handed out, and one button to ta"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ke it
back. An invite is valid for 24 hours, survives restarts, and whoever holds
it can pair, so th"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"is is the only way to stop one that leaked.
- **Inbox** — everything that arrived, where it landed, "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"and exporting a copy
elsewhere.
- **Transfers** — history, with pause / resume / cancel offered only"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" where the
CLI will accept them.
- **Settings** — this machine's device name and receive directory. "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"Each value
says where it comes from, and when an environment variable is winning it says
what is bei"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ng held down — otherwise you would edit a field that does nothing.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## A limitation you should know about"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"dsh refuses to read a session log containing an event type it does not know,
unless the event is mar"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ked `ignorable`. Neither escape is available to a
third-party plugin: the known set is generated fro"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"m the types declared inside the
dsh repository, and `Session.append()` offers no way to set the mark"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"er. dsh knows
— its own source says a registration surface for out-of-repo events "is deferred
until"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" such a consumer exists"."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"This plugin is that consumer, so at load it announces its four event types to the
running harness. T"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"hat makes them readable here. It does **not** put `ignorable`
on the events, so:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> **Disable this plugin rather than uninstalling it**, if conversations that used
> it still matter "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"to you. A harness without the plugin refuses to open a session
> log containing its events — you wou"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ld see "unknown to this harness", and the
> whole conversation, not just the SwarmDrop rows, becomes"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"own to this harness", and the
> whole conversation, not just the SwarmDrop rows, becomes unreadable."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The announcement also relies on the plugin and dsh resolving the same
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` mod"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ule instance. That holds for an ordinary install;
it does not hold when dsh is run from a source che"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ckout under `tsx`, where the
two halves get separate module graphs and the announcement lands on a c"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" where the
two halves get separate module graphs and the announcement lands on a copy
nothing reads."}],"truncated":true}
